title: Value of the vector enumeration
statement: For every natural number $\ell$ and every index $i<2^\ell$, the binary vector enumeration equivalence sends $i$ to the entry of the recursively defined list of all binary vectors of length $\ell$ at the corresponding index under the canonical identification of that list's length with $2^\ell$.
